name: Tomatillo

schedule.notes: MUST plant at least 2 — self-incompatible, won't set fruit alone.
Pick when husks split or are filled tightly. Pick paler-green for tartness; let yellow for sweeter.

harvest.cues: Husk is bursting at the seams or has split open. Fruit firm, sticky, vibrant green or yellow.
harvest.storageNotes: Husks on, paper bag at room temp 2 to 3 weeks. Husked: fridge 1 week.

varieties.name: Purple de Milpa
varieties.notes: Purple-blushed, smaller, sweeter. Heirloom from Mexico.

notes: Self-infertile — plant 2+ for fruit set. Sprawls aggressively; cage them or let them roam. Volunteers come back forever once you've grown them once.
